scientific_question: Did the fixed 1280-column v190 coreset fail because one geometry-only scalar condition is bad, or because the selected-column least-squares metric distorts different deployment-visible observation directions differently within the same fixed geometry?
role: post-open retrospective mechanism attribution on the already-open v189/v190 four-frame roster; it does not propose or evaluate a replacement algorithm

already_seen_before_freeze: v189 full-DCT K1 passed all 52 cells in both sensor arms
v190 QDEIM1280 K1 passed 35/52 five-camera cells and 30/52 all-nine cells
v190 per-calibration strict-cell counts in the sealed formal and independent reports
not_computed_before_freeze: reconstructed full and selected normal matrices
pre_audit_disclosure.claim_boundary: Mixed pass/fail rows are not presented as a newly blinded discovery. The new scientific increment is the sealed-array and independently reconstructed normal-metric attribution, with exact numerical diagnostics fixed here before those arrays are read.

data_isolation.scientific_arrays: read only the sealed v189/v190 full-DCT and QDEIM1280 coordinates, heldout features, selected indices and K1 metrics for the same p=22kw_size=01 frames 0,25,75,100
data_isolation.geometry_reconstruction: rebuild exactly the same 26 full response matrices from the frozen affine basis, reported calibrations and camera rosters; no new truth field or validation/test trajectory is loaded
forbidden_inputs: PoolFire validation, stopping-validation or test trajectories
new CFD truth, real BOST data or external test data
trajectory, time, power or size as a selection or prediction feature
post-result thresholds, alternative coresets, weights, budgets, regularizers, fallbacks or predictors

fixed_diagnostics.mixed_setup: for one fixed sensor arm and calibration, the four v190 K1 strict-cell decisions contain at least one pass and at least one fail
fixed_diagnostics.coordinate_delta: d = c_selected - c_full, where c_full is the sealed v189 full-DCT coordinate and c_selected is the sealed v190 QDEIM1280 coordinate
fixed_diagnostics.within_setup_delta_spread: maximum pairwise norm(d_i-d_j) over the four frames divided by max_i norm(d_i), with float64 epsilon floor
fixed_diagnostics.full_normal_defect: norm((c_selected H_full - h_full) H_full^T) / max(norm(h_full H_full^T), float64 epsilon)
fixed_diagnostics.selected_normal_stationarity: norm((c_selected H_selected - h_selected) H_selected^T) / max(norm(h_selected H_selected^T), float64 epsilon)
fixed_diagnostics.delta_energy_selected_fraction: norm(d H_selected)^2 / max(norm(d H_full)^2, float64 epsilon)
fixed_diagnostics.delta_energy_discarded_fraction: 1 - delta_energy_selected_fraction, independently cross-checked by explicitly gathering discarded columns
fixed_diagnostics.trace_normalized_directional_ratio: [d G_selected d^T / trace(G_selected)] / [d G_full d^T / trace(G_full)]
fixed_diagnostics.generalized_metric_spectrum: eigenvalues of trace(G_full)/trace(G_selected) times G_selected v = lambda G_full v, with both matrices symmetrized

required_validity_gates: the complete v189 and v190 formal, independent and decision trees remain byte-identical
the reconstructed full responses reproduce v190 full singular values, row norms, Frobenius norms and response sketches within 1e-8
the reconstructed selected responses reproduce v190 selected indices, singular values, row norms, Frobenius norms and response sketches within 1e-8
the sealed v190 selected heldout features equal exact gathers from sealed v189 full heldout features
formal recomputation of full and selected coordinates matches the sealed v189 and v190 coordinates within 1e-8
v189 K1 is strict-safe in all 104 cells and v190 K1 masks reproduce the sealed report counts
selected normal stationarity is at most 1e-7 for every cell
selected plus explicitly discarded delta energy reconstructs full delta energy within 1e-10 relative
all fixed diagnostics are finite and have their frozen shapes
formal inputs and source worktree remain unchanged
the independent implementation reconstructs responses and diagnostics without importing the formal v191 analysis module or runner
formal_decision_order: Any binding, seal, response-reconstruction, gather, inverse, mask, stationarity, energy-identity, finite, shape or source-cleanliness failure makes v191 inconclusive.
If there is no mixed setup, conclude NO_MIXED_FIXED_GEOMETRY_OUTCOME_V191 and do not authorize observation-adaptive follow-up from this diagnostic.

If at least one mixed setup exists, every mixed setup has within-setup coordinate-delta spread above 1e-8, and every v190 failed cell has coordinate-delta-relative and full-normal-defect above 1e-8 while its selected normal stationarity remains at most 1e-7, conclude PASS_OBSERVATION_ACTIVATED_NORMAL_METRIC_DISTORTION_ATTRIBUTION_PENDING_INDEPENDENT_V191.
Otherwise conclude INCONCLUSIVE_OBSERVATION_ACTIVATED_NORMAL_METRIC_ATTRIBUTION_V191. Do not retune thresholds or select a favorable subset of calibrations or frames.

must_rebuild: all 26 full responses with the independent camera-feature implementation
selected responses from the sealed indices
full and selected coordinates using an independent LAPACK driver
strict masks, mixed setups, normal defects, selected/discarded energies, directional ratios and generalized spectra
all parent and input seals before and after validation
independent_recomputation.scientific_decision: Only an all-valid independent match may seal PASS_OBSERVATION_ACTIVATED_NORMAL_METRIC_DISTORTION_ATTRIBUTION_V191.

authorization_boundary.if_independent_attribution_passes: authorize only a separately frozen minimal observation-adaptive coordinate-capacity diagnostic on the same already-open development roster, with one deterministic deployment-visible mechanism and cheap controls
not_authorized: CNN, FNO, UNO, DeepONet or larger-model rescue
new exact-call, wall-time or RSS claims
external generalization, curved-ray or real-BOST claims
